map.提取 IP 地址是做什么的？: What does Text Extract Ips do?
map.如何使用提取 IP 地址？: How do I use Text Extract Ips?
map.提取 IP 地址适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Text Extract Ips best for?
map.安全审计与日志分析：从访问日志抽出来源/目标 IPv4，定位异常流量。: Security auditing and log analysis: pull source/destination IPv4 from access logs to locate abnormal traffic.
map.网络排查：汇总设备 IP 做资产与连通性核对。: Network troubleshooting: collect device IPs for asset and connectivity checks.
map.数据脱敏预检：先抽全部 IP 再决定是否打码。: Pre-redaction screening: extract all IPs, then decide whether to mask them.
map.日志含「192.168.1.10 - - [..]」「203.0.113.5 -: Logs contain "192.168.1.10 - - [..]" and "203.0.113.5 - - [...]"; the tool extracts two IPv4 addresses and counts occurrences to spot high-frequency sources.
map.可在选项开启 IPv6 匹配（如 2001:db8::1）；默认多按 IPv4，: You can enable IPv6 matching in the options (e.g. 2001:db8::1); the default is mostly IPv4 to avoid misreading ordinary colon-separated numbers.
map.私网和公网怎么区分？: How are private and public networks distinguished?
map.抽得后按 RFC 1918（10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16）: After extraction, private ranges are labelled per RFC 1918 (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) to distinguish internal from external sources.
